name: session-3
title: Session 3: Glitter board, blink and creator checks
requires: MO2 profile 'XF Studio diagnostic 2026-09-25' with XF Eye Artistry (the experiment 021 Glitter board) and XF Runtime Bridge (-writes build of batch 3 or later, with its XF camera presets)
a loaded save with V in the world, in an open spot
a fresh manual safety save (step p0-ready)
the game window in front (photo.open presses the photo-mode key in it)

steps.label: p0-ready
steps.text: Before anything changes: (1) make a new manual save now. This profile shares your save folder, and once the bridge changes something, saving stays locked until you load a save. (2) Tell the coordinator the resolution (the bridge has read the graphics settings; p0-options). (3) Check that the XF selector lists Off plus six Glitter presets. Stand V in an open, quiet spot with room in front of her (photo mode's camera needs a few metres); keep the game window in front.

steps.label: a-first-open-fallback
steps.text: If the character creator didn't open by itself, open it (a mirror, or F12 with Character Customization Anywhere).

steps.label: a-a-confirm-fallback
steps.text: If the creator is still open, press Confirm yourself (the look is kept until the safety save is loaded).

steps.label: a-a-photo-fallback
steps.text: If photo mode didn't open by itself, press the photo mode key.

steps.text: If the character creator didn't open by itself, open it (a mirror, or F12 with Character Customization Anywhere).

steps.label: a-b-photo-fallback
steps.text: If photo mode didn't open by itself, press the photo mode key.

steps.label: a-c-dlaa
steps.text: Card step 5: switch the upscaler to DLAA (or its highest-quality mode) in the graphics settings, then come back to the world.

steps.label: a-c-dlaa-photo-fallback
steps.text: If photo mode didn't open by itself, press the photo mode key.

steps.label: a-c-dlaa-undo
steps.text: Set the upscaler back to how it was.

steps.label: a-e-dark
steps.text: Card step 7: is the accent still visible at night? Does it bloom? Would it be acceptable as a labelled stylised option?

steps.label: a-clear-open-fallback
steps.text: If the character creator didn't open by itself, open it (a mirror, or F12 with Character Customization Anywhere).

steps.label: a-motion
steps.text: Card step 8: with Glitter A (set it again if needed), watch a blink and turn V slowly. Did the E → A → Off switch leave any glowing points behind?

steps.label: a-winterkissed
steps.text: Optional card step 9: only if Winterkissed is already enabled, equip Golden Girl for a reference close-up (don't change the mod list for this). Otherwise skip.

steps.label: b-back-fallback
steps.text: If the creator is still open, press Back and confirm.

steps.label: b-open-fallback
steps.text: If the character creator didn't open by itself, open it (a mirror, or F12 with Character Customization Anywhere). The eye-shape and cyberware rows need the ripperdoc's screen or F12; a mirror doesn't offer them.

steps.label: b-makeup-closed
steps.text: Eye shape 12 is set. Pick an XF look covering the upper lid (the coordinator can name one), then watch a blink: does bare skin show between the crease and the lashes when the eyes close?

steps.label: c-legacy-off
steps.text: Part C step 4 (needs the legacy build on the reference character; otherwise skip): set every legacy XF layer row, lipstick and blush to Off. Does anything remain drawn?

steps.label: c-hair-check
steps.text: Coordinator (card step 5, CC file chain 11): compare c-hair-5-shot with c-hair-cyberware-shot; the same hair means the Studio's switcher rule holds, the same position with different hair means it changes. If a colour step failed, read the row and repeat it with its index.

steps.label: c-creator-rows
steps.text: Step 6 needs a new game's body page; note the rows in order and any unlabelled row the next time a new game is started. Skip it here.

steps.label: c-back-fallback
steps.text: If the creator is still open, press Back and confirm.

steps.label: d-start
steps.text: Part D (optional): photo mode for expressions.

steps.label: d-photo-fallback
steps.text: If photo mode didn't open by itself, press the photo mode key.

steps.label: d-menu-sleeping
steps.text: Pick Static: Sleeping from the photo-mode expression menu yourself.

steps.label: d-cet
steps.text: R1 (which facial setup photo mode uses) and XF.graph() still need the CET console lines on the session 3 card; they are optional.

steps.label: wrap
steps.text: Done. Load the safety save: it restores your usual look, the time of day and the save lock.
